lines.text: Oh, fear! We're done for! They're bringing in the main ship!
Bringing out the big guns, huh?
Why don't we try using the secret weapon you were telling us about?
Huh? Oh, that. Won't make any difference. It's broken.
Well, I'll fix it then. Come on, Mega Man!
Get her back, Mega Man! It's our job to stop the pirates, not hers!
